name: Google Chat
description: Google Chat is a team messaging and collaboration app within Google Workspace, offering direct messages, group spaces, and Gemini-powered AI features integrated with Gmail, Drive, and Meet.
best_for: Organizations using Google Workspace that want team messaging tightly integrated with Gmail, Drive, Calendar, and Meet.
features: Direct messages and group conversations (Spaces) supporting up to 500,000 members
Message threading, emoji reactions, and rich text formatting
Smart chips linking directly to Drive files and other content
Gemini in Chat for message translation, summaries, and composition assistance
Task creation and management within spaces
Native support for 100+ third-party apps including Jira, Asana, and GitHub
Seamless Meet integration for launching video calls

alternatives.name: Slack
alternatives.description: A channel-based team messaging platform with deep app integrations and workflow automation.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting rich integrations and channel-based communication

alternatives.name: Microsoft Teams
alternatives.description: A collaboration hub combining chat, video meetings, and file sharing tightly integrated with Microsoft 365.
strengths: Chat and video in one app

alternatives.name: Mattermost
alternatives.description: An open-source, self-hostable team messaging platform designed for technical and security-conscious teams.

pricing.starting_price: Free with a Google Account; included with Google Workspace at no additional Chat fee, with Business Starter at $7/user/month

tiers.name: Google Account
tiers.notes: Google Chat can be used with a Google Account. Business administration and some premium features require Google Workspace.

tiers.name: Workspace Business Starter
tiers.notes: Standard list price per user/month before temporary promotions; Chat is included as part of the Workspace bundle.

tiers.name: Workspace Business Standard
tiers.notes: Standard list price per user/month; includes broader Workspace and Gemini features.

tiers.name: Workspace Business Plus
tiers.notes: Standard list price per user/month; adds higher storage, security, and meeting capabilities.

tiers.name: Workspace Enterprise
tiers.notes: Contact sales; Chat is included within the Enterprise Workspace bundle.

cons: Google Chat does not have a separate business subscription price: business capabilities are bundled into Google Workspace, so teams pay for the broader Workspace plan rather than Chat alone.
For work or school accounts, the organization must configure and enable Chat; users who cannot see Chat may need their Workspace administrator to turn it on.
Some AI and business features shown on Google's Chat product pages are available only on qualifying Workspace Business or Enterprise plans.
